title: Coverage Record
description: One cell of the domain × check × subscription × resource type coverage matrix described in knowledge/scaling.md. Partial or sampled runs use these canonical cells to make clear what was assessed, skipped, failed, permission-denied, sampled, or partial.

check_id.description: The check that produced this cell, e.g. nsg-mgmt-port-open-internet.

subscription_id.description: Azure subscription ID for this coverage cell.

status.description: Coverage outcome for this domain × check × subscription × resource type cell.

count.description: Number of resources this cell represents.

reason.description: Optional explanation for a skipped, failed, permission-denied, sampled, or partial cell.
